shellCommands.command: cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'

ls node_modules/next/dist/server/web/ 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "---EXPORTS---"; grep -rn "export.*revalidateTag\|export.*unstable_cache" node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/ 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -rn "revalidateTag\|updateTag\|unstable_cache\|revalidatePath" node_modules/next/dist/server/next.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "==="; find node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension -name "revalidate.d.ts" -exec cat {} \;

cat node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/unstable-cache.d.ts; echo "=== re-exports ==="; grep -rn "revalidateTag\|updateTag\|unstable_cache\|revalidatePath\|refresh" node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/lib/constants.d.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -i "export" | head; echo "=== next/server index ==="; grep -rn "revalidateTag\|updateTag\|unstable_cache\|revalidatePath" node_modules/next/dist/server/next-imports.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -rln "revalidateTag\|updateTag" node_modules/next/dist/server/*.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/next-imports.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== find next-imports ==="; find node_modules/next/dist -name "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -l "export.*revalidateTag" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== check next/cache ==="; find node_modules/next/dist -path "*cache*" -name "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -l "revalidateTag\|unstable_cache" 2>/dev/null | head

grep -rn "revalidateTag\|updateTag\|unstable_cache\|revalidatePath" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack/require-hook.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/require-hook.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== how next/server resolves ==="; grep -rn "revalidateTag\|updateTag" node_modules/next/dist/server/runtime.js node_modules/next/dist/server/runtime.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== check types for next/server ==="; find node_modules/next -maxdepth 3 -name "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -l "module 'next/server'" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== grep next/server in types ==="; grep -rn "next/server" node_modules/next/dist/server/next.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

find node_modules/next/dist -name "next.d.ts" | head; echo "==="; cat node_modules/next/dist/server/web/exports/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo "=== exports dir ==="; ls node_modules/next/dist/server/web/exports/ 2>/dev/null
cat node_modules/next/dist/server/web/exports/index.d.ts
cat node_modules/next/dist/server/next.d.ts

cat node_modules/next/dist/after.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== after.js ==="; head -30 node_modules/next/dist/after.js 2>/dev/null; echo "=== require-hook re-exports ==="; grep -n "revalidateTag\|updateTag\|unstable_cache\|revalidatePath\|after\|refresh" node_modules/next/dist/server/require-hook.js 2>/dev/null | head -30

find node_modules/next/dist -name "after*" -type f 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== require-hook ==="; grep -rn "revalidateTag\|unstable_cache\|after" node_modules/next/dist/server/require-hook.* 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== how next/server is built (imports map) ==="; find node_modules/next/dist -name "*.js" -path "*server*" | xargs grep -l "spec-extension/revalidate" 2>/dev/null | head

find node_modules/next/dist -maxdepth 2 -name "after.*" 2>/dev/null; echo "=== after dir ==="; ls node_modules/next/dist/server/after/ 2>/dev/null; echo "=== after.d.ts ==="; cat node_modules/next/dist/server/after/after.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== how next/server re-exports (compiled) ==="; grep -rn "revalidateTag\|updateTag\|unstable_cache\|after" node_modules/next/dist/server/web/exports/index.js 2>/dev/null | head

grep -rn "revalidateTag\|updateTag\|unstable_cache\|revalidatePath" node_modules/next/dist/server/web/exports/index.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== next-imports / require hook mapping ==="; grep -rn "revalidateTag\|updateTag\|unstable_cache\|revalidatePath" node_modules/next/dist/server/require-hook.js node_modules/next/dist/lib/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "=== search compiled next/server entry ==="; find node_modules/next/dist -name "server.js" -path "*dist*" | head; grep -rln "spec-extension/revalidate" node_modules/next/dist/server/ 2>/dev/null | head
cat node_modules/next/dist/esm/api/server.js 2>/dev/null | head -80

find node_modules/next/dist -name "cache.d.ts" -o -name "cache.js" 2>/dev/null | grep -v incremental | grep -v response | head; echo "=== next/cache ==="; find node_modules/next -maxdepth 3 -name "cache*" -type f 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== grep docs for import source ==="; grep -rn "from 'next/server'\|from \"next/server\"" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/revalidateTag.md 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== unstable_cache doc ==="; grep -rn "import\|from 'next" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/unstable_cache.md 2>/dev/null | head

cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts; echo "=== cache.js ==="; cat node_modules/next/cache.js; echo "=== revalidateTag doc import ==="; grep -rn "from 'next" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/revalidateTag.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/updateTag.md 2>/dev/null | head
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40; echo "TSC_EXIT=$?"
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -50; echo "BUILD_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

grep -rln "syncCatalog\|revalidateTag\|products" .next/server/app/admin/catalog/ 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== action manifest ==="; find .next -name "action*" -o -name "*action-manifest*" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== grep action-manifest content ==="; find .next -name "*.json" | xargs grep -l "syncCatalog\|admin/catalog" 2>/dev/null | head
cat .next/server/app/admin/catalog/page/server-reference-manifest.json 2>/dev/null | head -60

grep -rln "005ea87135f47a43213386d1ca9bff56f499ed6bfd\|syncCatalog\|createServerReference" .next/server/app/admin/catalog/ 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== check page chunk for action binding ==="; grep -rn "005ea87135f47a43213386d1ca9bff56f499ed6bfd" .next/server/ 2>/dev/null | head -5
npx next start -p 3137

curl -s -o /tmp/catalog.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3137/admin/catalog; echo "=== contains key elements ==="; grep -c "Product Catalog\|Sync latest catalog\|Laptop\|In stock\|Unavailable" /tmp/catalog.html; echo "=== sample ==="; grep -o "Sync latest catalog" /tmp/catalog.html | head -1; grep -o "Product Catalog" /tmp/catalog.html | head -1; grep -o "In stock" /tmp/catalog.html | head -1

grep -o '<form[^>]*action="[^"]*"' /tmp/catalog.html | head -1; echo "=== hidden action id input? ==="; grep -o 'name="[^"]*ACTION_ID[^"]*"\|name="[^"]*_action[^"]*"\|ACTION_ID' /tmp/catalog.html | head; echo "=== look for encrypted action reference in form ==="; grep -oE '\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+' /tmp/catalog.html | head -3

ACTION_ID='$ACTION_ID_005ea87135f47a43213386d1ca9bff56f499ed6bfd'; RSC='1'; curl -s -o /tmp/action_resp.txt -w "HTTP %{http_code} time=%{time_total}s\n" -X POST http://localhost:3137/admin/catalog -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -H "Next-Action: 005ea87135f47a43213386d1ca9bff56f499ed6bfd" --data-urlencode "$ACTION_ID=1"; echo "=== response head ==="; head -c 400 /tmp/action_resp.txt; echo; echo "=== re-fetch page to confirm still serves (stale-while-revalidate) ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/catalog2.html -w "HTTP %{http_code} time=%{time_total}s\n" http://localhost:3137/admin/catalog

ACTION_ID='$ACTION_ID_005ea87135f47a43213386d1ca9bff56f499ed6bfd'; echo "=== form POST (as browser would, no Next-Action header) ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/action2.txt -w "HTTP %{http_code} time=%{time_total}s\n" -X POST http://localhost:3137/admin/catalog -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --data-urlencode "$ACTION_ID=1" -H "Accept: text/x-component"; echo "=== response head ==="; head -c 300 /tmp/action2.txt; echo; echo "=== check server logs for action/sync ===";

echo "=== prices BEFORE (initial prerendered values) ==="; grep -oE '\$[0-9]+' /tmp/catalog.html | head -5; echo "=== wait for background sync to settle (2s) ==="; sleep 2; echo "=== re-fetch page (cache should refill with drifted prices) ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/catalog3.html -w "HTTP %{http_code} time=%{time_total}s\n" http://localhost:3137/admin/catalog; echo "=== prices AFTER ==="; grep -oE '\$[0-9]+' /tmp/catalog3.html | head -5

echo "=== initial prerender (catalog.html) price cells ==="; grep -oE '>\$[0-9]+<' /tmp/catalog.html | head -8; echo "=== after sync (catalog3.html) price cells ==="; grep -oE '>\$[0-9]+<' /tmp/catalog3.html | head -8; echo "=== server log tail ==="

grep -oE '\$[0-9]{2,4}' /tmp/catalog.html | head -8; echo "---after---"; grep -oE '\$[0-9]{2,4}' /tmp/catalog3.html | head -8; echo "=== raw context around Laptop ==="; grep -oE 'Laptop.{0,120}' /tmp/catalog.html | head -1; grep -oE 'Laptop.{0,120}' /tmp/catalog3.html | head -1

echo "=== action POST response: check for error vs success markers ==="; grep -oE 'error|Error|exception|redirect|revalidate' /tmp/action2.txt | sort | uniq -c | head; echo "=== response length ==="; wc -c /tmp/action2.txt; echo "=== does it contain a fresh RSC payload (action result)? ==="; grep -c 'x-component' /tmp/action2.txt; head -c 120 /tmp/action2.txt; echo

ACTION_ID='$ACTION_ID_005ea87135f47a43213386d1ca9bff56f499ed6bfd'; echo "=== RSC-style action POST ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/action3.txt -w "HTTP %{http_code} time=%{time_total}s
" -X POST http://localhost:3137/admin/catalog -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----boundary" -H "Accept: text/x-component" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%5D" -H "RSC: 1" --data-binary $'------boundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="'"$ACTION_ID"'"

1
------boundary--
'; echo "=== response head (RSC stream) ==="; head -c 500 /tmp/action3.txt; echo; echo "=== check for action result / revalidation markers ==="; grep -oE 'revalidate|stale|products|\$0|\$1' /tmp/action3.txt | sort | uniq -c | head

ACTION_ID='$ACTION_ID_005ea87135f47a43213386d1ca9bff56f499ed6bfd'; curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -X POST http://localhost:3137/admin/catalog -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----boundary" -H "Accept: text/x-component" -H "RSC: 1" --data-binary $'------boundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="'"$ACTION_ID"'"

1
------boundary--
' | grep -iE 'HTTP|location|vary|x-action'
